name: A successful Aneurysm interrupt heals the Bloodmage for 5% of maximum health (#3713)
contract: Spell.dbc gives Aneurysm 806099 DurationIndex 35 (4000 ms school lockout), RecoveryTime 24000, Mechanic 26 (MECHANIC_INTERRUPT), RangeIndex 4 (30 yds), PowerType -2 with ManaCostPercentage 10, and a single effect 68 (SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST) with TargetA 6. Its tooltip adds 'Successfully interrupting an enemy heals you for $520860s1% of your maximum health'. 520860 exists as a single SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL_PCT of 5% on the caster and nothing in the source or the world DB ever cast it, while Spell::EffectInterruptCast already raises OnSpellSuccessfulInterrupt only when an interrupt actually landed. Fixture: Scholomance Dark Summoner 11582 runs SmartAI with an in-combat event that casts Summon Risen Lackey 17618 on itself (4000 ms cast, PreventionType SPELL_PREVENTION_TYPE_SILENCE, InterruptFlags 0x9) 2-5 sec after engaging and again every 5-7 sec. Self-targeted is required because harness creatures are forced REACT_PASSIVE (CoAGameplayTest.cpp), so they never acquire a victim and SmartAI actions aimed at one never resolve; the same passivity means the fixture never strikes back, so no melee noise reaches the measurement. QA Test +10000 HP/MP 10040 at 20 stacks raises maximum health by about 200000 without touching create health, so Aneurysm's own cost (10% of create health, a few hundred) is negligible against the 5% heal, and health is then set to 50000 so the heal is not clipped by the cap. The contract is therefore a clearly positive health-percentage step across the interrupt, where the unhealed behaviour can only lose the cast's own health cost. The opening wait is 26000 ms rather than a short settle because the same creature also runs an out-of-combat SmartAI event (smart_scripts entry 11582 id 0, SMART_EVENT_UPDATE_OOC, initial 1000-20000 ms) casting Summon Frail Skeleton 16531 on itself, a 5000 ms cast whose PreventionType is SPELL_PREVENTION_TYPE_NONE and which Spell::EffectInterruptCast therefore never interrupts, while the harness's casting metric is Unit::IsNonMeleeSpellCast(false) and cannot tell the two casts apart. 20000 + 5000 bounds that cast, so 26000 ms clears it, and SmartScript::UpdateTimer freezes the out-of-combat timer while the creature is engaged, so it cannot recur once the attack lands; the mid-cast gate can then catch only the in-combat casts: Summon Risen Lackey 17618, Curse of Blood 12279 (2000 ms) and the Drain Life 17620 channel, all Shadow with PreventionType SPELL_PREVENTION_TYPE_SILENCE and the interrupt flag. A creature's instant channel is set as its current spell in SPELL_STATE_PREPARING and starts at its next spell update, and Spell::EffectInterruptCast skips a PREPARING spell without a cast time, so an interrupt landing in that one update was ignored and the channel then ran its full 5000 ms (seen with Drain Life at 5000 ms left after the interrupt); the scenario therefore lets the detected cast run 500 ms and checks it is still in progress before interrupting. timeout_ms is 120000 to cover the wait.

steps.label: Let the out-of-combat Summon Frail Skeleton cast finish
A channel is interruptible only after its first update starts it, so let the cast run
The fixture caster is still mid-cast
Health percentage just before the interrupt
Regression guard: the native interrupt stopped the cast
The interrupt heals the Bloodmage for 5% of maximum health
